**Q: What is Kavusik Rosan known for?**  
A: Kavusik Rosan is primarily known for creating Obscura Arcanum — a nationally recognized anti-AI image protection platform that uses adversarial ML and encryption to protect digital media from unauthorized AI scraping and exploitation. The project was shortlisted in the Top 100 nationally at both AICTE APF 2025 and Yukti Challenge 2025. He is also known as an HCL GUVI Campus Ambassador who has mentored over 200 students.

**Q: What projects has Kavusik Rosan built?**  
A: Kavusik Rosan has built six major projects:
1. **Obscura Arcanum** — Anti-AI image protection system using adversarial ML (Top 100 AICTE APF 2025, Yukti Challenge 2025)
2. **Virtual Navigator** — Real-time hand-gesture navigation using Python, OpenCV and MediaPipe
3. **Link Shift** — Serverless E2E encrypted P2P messaging and file transfer via WebRTC
4. **DeepLynk** — Android security app blocking trackers, phishing, and hidden ads
5. **Autoform Assist** — AI-powered mobile app for automatic form filling using OCR and NLP
6. **Obscura Dravion** — Biometric intelligence system for rapid video archive search with privacy safeguards

A: Obscura Arcanum is an advanced anti-AI image protection system created by Kavusik Rosan. It uses adversarial machine learning and multi-layer encryption to prevent unauthorized AI systems from exploiting or training on protected digital images. ## PROFILE SUMMARY

**Kavusik Rosan** is a final-year Computer Science Engineering student (2023–2027) at Sri Shakthi Institute of Engineering and Technology, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. He is a Digital Marketing & SEO Specialist who is skilled in Keyword Research, On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Content Optimization, Search Analytics, Website Optimization, Organic Growth Strategies, Digital Branding, and Google Search Console fundamentals. He holds certifications in Digital Marketing & Content, Creative & Media Skills, Leadership & Communication, and Business & Professional Skills.

He is the creator of **Obscura Arcanum**, an anti-AI image protection platform that combines adversarial ML techniques and cryptographic encryption to prevent unauthorized AI exploitation of digital media. This platform was shortlisted **Top 100 nationally** at both AICTE APF 2025 and Yukti Challenge 2025.

As **HCL GUVI Campus Ambassador** under Mission Upskill India, Kavusik organizes hackathons, mentors 200+ students, and leads technical initiatives on campus. He has served as Department Newsletter & Magazine Head at SIET, published technical content on the GUVI platform, and has an academic author profile at HBRP Publication (JRRFIH journal).
